Resolves #19966

Hiding a `document.body`-rooted component while one of its updates was in flight left its children marked `mounted` under an unmounted root: the late landing re-marked them. The next show found nothing to change, so no child's mount hook ran, and a grid header menu reopened after an `Escape` inside that window had no Navigator on its value list. `syncVnodeTree()` now mounts children only while the root's DOM is live (`me.mounted || !me.vdom.removeDom`). A late landing still hands out its vnodes, and the root's next mount mounts the children.

Evidence: L3 (local headless Chromium, `playwright.config.e2e.mjs`: a deterministic arm red on base and green at head, and the `#19928` arm under 8 workers) → L3 required (AC-2, AC-4).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/component/MountFlight.spec.mjs`, "mounts no child, and the next show mounts them again (#19966)". |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs`, "a menu closed while its surface update is in flight keeps its value navigation when reopened (#19966)". |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI receipt under Test Evidence: both arms are red on base and green at head. |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI receipt under Test Evidence: the `#19928` arm, 24 runs under 8 workers, base and head. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The e2e arm closes after the payload leaves.** A close inside `executeVdomUpdate`'s macrotask yield, before the payload is collected, ships the root's `removeDom`, mounts nothing, and passed on base. The arm closes right after `Neo.vdom.Helper.updateBatch` posts the payload, the order an `Escape` takes in the flake.

## Test Evidence

Local, this branch; base is the same tree with the fix stashed.

- **Unit arm:** base fails at "the late landing leaves the child unmounted" (received `true`); head passes, `MountFlight.spec.mjs` 5/5.
- **E2E arm, 3 runs each:** base 3/3 red (the reopened menu shows no `.neo-navigator-active-item`); head 3/3 green.
- **The `#19928` arm, `--repeat-each=24 --workers=8`:** base 6 failed and 18 passed; head 24/24.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted in this repo.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket #19966 (`An update landing after unmount() marks the root's children mounted`), changed-file list (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs`, `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/component/MountFlight.spec.mjs`), current `dev` source of `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs` (`initVnode`, `onInitVnode`, `executeVdomUpdate`, `syncVnodeTree`), `src/component/Base.mjs` (`show`, `hide`, `unmount`), and `src/container/Base.mjs` (`afterSetMounted`), plus Memory Core prior-art sweep (`query_raw_memories` on `syncVnodeTree unmount mounted executeVdomUpdate`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `Neo.mixin.VdomLifecycle#syncVnodeTree` must still adopt incoming child `_vnode` references and run `afterVnodeSync` / `unmountRemovedChildren` when an in-flight update lands after `unmount()`, but must only set `component.mounted = true` while the receiver root's DOM is live or initializing (`me.mounted || !me.vdom.removeDom`). It must not hardcode floating-menu or `document.body` caller specifics inside `VdomLifecycle`, and it must be verified by both an isolated unit test holding an update flight across `unmount()` and a browser e2e test closing the grid header menu after `updateBatch` dispatches.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape. `syncVnodeTree()` computes `mountsChildren = me.mounted || !me.vdom.removeDom` once and gates `if (mountsChildren) component.mounted = true`, preserving initial render (`initVnode` deletes `me.vdom.removeDom` before `onInitVnode` triggers `syncVnodeTree`) while keeping children `mounted: false` when an update flight lands after `unmount()` sets `me.vdom.removeDom = true` and `me.mounted = false`.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with **Verify-Before-Assert** and **Friction → Gold**: the intermittent `#19928` CI flake was traced empirically via `afterSetMounted` call stacks to a general VDOM lifecycle invariant gap in `syncVnodeTree` and fixed at the engine root with deterministic unit and e2e regression arms.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: `mountsChildren = me.mounted || !me.vdom.removeDom` relies on the unmounted root itself carrying `vdom.removeDom === true` (which `Component#unmount()` and `Component#hide()` set on the root). If a nested child container `C` inside a `document.body`-rooted ancestor `A` ever has its own disjoint update flight in `inFlightScopes` when `A.unmount()` cascades `C.mounted = false` (without setting `C.vdom.removeDom = true`), `C.syncVnodeTree` would still see `!C.vdom.removeDom === true` while `C.mounted === false` and `!C.isVnodeInitializing`. Ticket #19966 explicitly scopes to the unmounted root's own update flight (`AC-1`), so this is non-blocking, but worth keeping in mind if a nested container inside a floating surface ever dispatches a disjoint update across parent `unmount()`.
